results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller-supplied `to` (address) and `tokenId` (uint256), along with caller context `msg.sender` as `auth`, reach `emit Approval(owner, to, tokenId)` and the storage write `_tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to`.
results.flow_security_relevance: Mutates `_tokenApprovals[tokenId]` to grant or revoke single-ticket transfer authority for a Raffle bearer ticket across any raffle lifecycle state before burn. Because `Raffle` tickets carry winning-prize and refund claims that require `ownerOf(ticketId)` at claim time, an approved `to` address can transfer the ticket to itself via `transferFrom`/`safeTransferFrom` and exercise those claims; additionally, `_approve` does not run `Raffle._isProtocolDestination(to, ...)`, deferring protocol-sink recipient validation to transfer time in `Raffle._update`.
results.flow_summary: An authorized caller (the current ticket owner or an operator approved for all of the owner's tickets via `setApprovalForAll`) approves address `to` for an existing, unburned raffle ticket `tokenId`, emitting `Approval` and writing `to` to `_tokenApprovals[tokenId]`.
results.flow_terminal_action: Emits `Approval(owner, to, tokenId)` and writes `_tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to` in `ERC721._approve`.
